# Bundled map renderer

- MapLibre GL JS **5.6.2**: https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@5.6.2/dist/ (BSD-3-Clause; see LICENSE.txt, including bundled dependency notices).
- MapLibre GL Leaflet **0.1.3**: https://unpkg.com/@maplibre/maplibre-gl-leaflet@0.1.3/ (ISC; see LEAFLET-LICENSE).

The browser builds are bundled locally so gameplay does not depend on a script CDN. The renderer uses the OpenFreeMap Liberty style and map data from https://tiles.openfreemap.org/; see https://openfreemap.org/quick_start/ for integration and attribution requirements. No API key is required.
